title: Mystery Minutes: The Missing Phone
one_line: A 3-minute mystery: search the room, find 3 clues, and accuse the right suspect before time runs out.
how_to_play: Tap around the room to search for clues, then tap "I know who did it" and pick the suspect you think is guilty.
description: Mystery Minutes is a beginner-friendly detective game built with plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, no libraries required. Your phone went missing from your room and four people were in the house today. You have 3 minutes to search five spots for 3 hidden clues (a keychain, muddy footprints, and a fabric thread), read each suspect's story, and make one accusation. Every clue points to a different random suspect each game, so no two cases play out the same way. Simple rules, one short case, works with mouse, touch, or keyboard on desktop and mobile browsers.
